title: Springfield, OH — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Springfield, OH: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Springfield is a city in OH with a population of 59,000. Champion City with the Hartman Rock Garden and the Wittenberg University. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree.
